# Font fixtures

`OpenSans-Bold-subset.ttf`: Open Sans Bold reduced to ASCII letters, digits
and a few punctuation marks (made with `cargo run -p basemapper-core
--example make_font_fixture`), for the SVG font tests. Open Sans is
